meta.name: The Royals
meta.description: When charming Prince Aviraaj meets Sophia, a self-made girl boss, the worlds of royalty and startups collide in a whirlwind of romance and ambition.

videos.title: A Royal Misunderstanding.
videos.overview: As she prepares to launch her new company, Sophia meets a handsome stranger. But their glaring differences stand in the way of their instant attraction.

videos.title: A Pitch Made in Heaven.
videos.overview: Aviraaj grapples with the palace's dwindling finances. Sophia's presentation to the royal family is blindsided by a competitor with a pitch of her own.

videos.title: A Swing and a Ms.
videos.overview: Sophia juggles a crumbling palace, an unruly Aviraaj and complex feelings for Kunal while managing a photo shoot. A celebrity sets his sights on Padmaja.

videos.title: A Ball to Remember.
videos.overview: Tensions rise at the Romeo and Juliet ball as Aviraaj resists Padmaja's efforts to set him up with his ex, Ayesha. Jinnie finds an unexpected romance.

videos.title: The Ex-Factor.
videos.overview: Aviraaj keeps ghosting Sophia as Ayesha approaches him with an intriguing proposition. Meanwhile, Diggy pours his efforts into pursuing a new passion.

videos.title: The Maharaja and the CEO.
videos.overview: The Royal BnB launch coincides with a painful anniversary for Sophia. After Aviraaj's coronation, a letter from his father reveals a shocking secret.

videos.title: The Maharaja who Loved.
videos.overview: Reeling from her recent betrayal, Sophia goes missing. After Aviraaj confronts Padmaja about his father's secret, Diggy and Jinnie share their own.

videos.title: Lights, Camera, AUCTION!
videos.overview: A steadfast Sophia throws her efforts into a fundraiser for the palace. Padmaja confronts the mysterious Maurice, and family secrets come to light.
